sub_agent_reviews.summary: Single merged Scout covered llm-agent, llm-post-training, and ai-safety; rank 1 was an exact duplicate, so rank 4 RA-Bench was selected from the same table.
Read arXiv page, arXiv HTML/PDF, official project page, GitHub README/EVALUATION, and dataset release inventory.
Mapped RA-Bench construction, source-matched aggregation, HumanProof, LastMile, metrics, and public-media/full coverage boundaries.
Separated proven detector failures from limits around visual-only I2V, controlled human review, and simulated dissemination.
Used the paper's benchmark comparison and official repository protocol rather than third-party summaries.
Article is pure Markdown with tables, formula-style blocks, and Mermaid; no external image URLs or frontmatter.
